title: Before you pick a side… pick TRUTH.
paragraphs: Before you pick a side… pick TRUTH.

Hindi ito movie. Hindi ito trailer. Totoong tao ang umiiyak. Totoong pamilya ang nadudurog habang ang mundo nanonood lang sa screen. When you hear of wars and rumors of wars… do not be alarmed — sabi ni Jesus (Mark 13:7), pero hindi Niya sinabing maging manhid tayo. Sa bawat bomba, may nanay na sumisigaw. Sa bawat missile, may batang hindi na makakatulog nang payapa. And while nations argue power, influence, strategy — ordinary people pay the price. Mga kapatid, this is not about choosing sides. This is about choosing TRUTH over propaganda, DISCERNMENT over panic, PRAYER over hatred. Huwag tayong maging instrumento ng fake news o blind rage. Verify before you share. Pray before you react. The real battle is not just physical — it is spiritual, it is moral, it is about the condition of the human heart. Lord, have mercy on Iran. Lord, have mercy on Israel. Lord, have mercy on all of us. Because when war becomes normal in our newsfeed, something in our soul is already in danger. #GospelWarrior #Discernment #prayforpeace
